name: cloud-wiki
description: Cloud Wiki (#1778, #1867): an encyclopedia of Markdown pages. No bottom nav: a collapsed left side menu (libs:ui-nav-bars vertical_side_menu) under three parents, Modern Science (hubs Sciences: Math, Computer Science, Physics, Astronomy, Engineering, Medicine; Humanities: Anthropology, Human Belief Systems; Arts: Art, Theater, Music, Movies; Explore: Graph), Arcanum Science (the Esoteric Arcanum master taxonomy: A Architecture of Sacred Sciences & Wisdom, B Interactions: Magic & Grimoires, C Esoteric Schools & Traditions, their sections I-V as topics and their leaves as pages, a historical and cultural encyclopedia, not instructions for practice) and Projects (Chronos, Sacred Geometry). A hub page shows its intro and its topics; each topic has its subpages as top tabs after an Overview tab. A page is a short, neutral, educational Markdown explanation with tag chips; tapping a chip filters every page by that tag. Graph is an Obsidian-style force-directed graph (libs:graph-view, shared with Cloud Notes) joining pages by their [[links]] and shared tags, with pan, zoom and tap to open. #1867 THE CONTENT IS THE REPO diegonmarcos/Projects-Library-KG: one numbered folder per node (1.Modern-science/1.0.Science/1.0.0.Math/1.0.0.0.Algebra/index.md, 2.Arcanum-science/..., 3.Projects/3.0.Chronos, 3.Projects/3.1.Sacred-geo), its root wiki.json generated from the tree by the repo's tools/gen-wiki.py. The app clones that repo at run time, read-only, into its own storage (libs:git-ui GitConnect, ChronosRepo; refreshed per the chosen mode, served offline from the clone) and reads the pages from the clone's wiki.json; until the first clone lands it reads the runtime dataset wiki (data/fleet/app/com.diegonmarcos.cloudwiki/wiki.json, the same file at the pin) served by Cloud Store. The Chronos simulators (3.Projects/3.0.Chronos, one nested page per index.html, in its hierarchy and with its titles) and the Sacred Geometry explorer are shown in the fleet web view (libs:web-core, APP_PAGE) from the clone through WebViewAssetLoader on the asset origin (every other request answered 403). The copy baked into the APK at the pin (tools/chronos-pin.json, tools/regen-chronos.py, drift-checked by test/test-chronos.sh) is the OFFLINE SEED served until the first clone; the same tool writes the side menu (ui.sections wiki pages and groups) and the Cloud Store dataset from the repo at the pin. Configs are the fleet's General | Perms | About.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Cloud Wiki. ui.bottom_nav is EMPTY: the app has no bottom nav (owner request, declared in nav-shape.json::no_bottom). The pages are the ONE section `wiki`, default_section, drawn in vertical_side_menu mode (the collapsed rail; libs:ui-nav-bars NavSectionLayout). #1867 GENERATED by tools/regen-chronos.py from the content repo's wiki.json `menu` at the pin, never typed: the groups are the repo's three parents (Modern Science, Arcanum Science, Projects); a hub page (Sciences, Humanities, Arts, Explore, A, B, C) holds its topics as nested pages (indented in the side menu, listed in the title dropdown); Chronos and Sacred Geometry (`project` = its folder) sit in Projects. Each topic page has its subpages as top tabs (the dataset's topics[id].pages), after an Overview tab; the Graph page draws every page as a node. test/test-wiki-1867.sh holds this declaration equal to the repo's menu and every page of the previous menu reachable; test-wiki-app.sh holds the topic ids in step with the dataset both ways. #1789 the Chronos page holds NESTED pages (from the repo's 3.Projects/3.0.Chronos at the pin): one per index.html, in its hierarchy, label = the page's name, `asset` = its file under assets/chronos (Decl.chronos reads it; NavDecl ignores the key); test-chronos.sh C1 holds the declaration equal to the baked tree.

configs_pages._doc: Configs > General and Configs > About (libs:ui-nav-bars fleetconfigs, rule 1_cicd/src/data/configs-pages.json, #1352 v2). general.sections: the anchors of the one General page, in order (perms, battery, storage, notifications, ui, language are required; app opens this app's own Configs; update is added after perms by default). about: the hand-written part of the extensive About: tagline, description, features, screens, guide, privacy, backends (ids of ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints, resolved to mesh URLs at build time), related fleet apps, credits for a fork. Permissions, data stores, crash/analytics libs, name, icon, version, build sha and date, repo, licence, origin, crash sink, debug API and changelog are derived, never typed here.

about.tagline: A small encyclopedia with a graph
about.description: Cloud Wiki is an encyclopedia of short, neutral, educational pages under three parents: Modern Science (sciences, humanities, arts), Arcanum Science (a historical and cultural encyclopedia of esoteric traditions, after the Esoteric Arcanum master taxonomy) and Projects. A collapsed side menu holds the hubs and topics, each topic has its subpages as top tabs, every page carries tag chips that filter the whole wiki, and the Graph page joins pages by their links and shared tags. The pages come from the Projects-Library-KG repository, which the app clones read-only and keeps for offline use; until the first clone Cloud Store serves the same pages, and a copy of the Chronos and Sacred Geometry sites baked into the app is the offline seed.
features: Modern Science > Sciences: Math, Computer Science, Physics, Astronomy, Engineering, Medicine
Modern Science > Humanities: Anthropology, Human Belief Systems
Modern Science > Arts: Art, Theater, Music, Movies
Modern Science > Explore: Graph (force-directed, pan, zoom, tap to open)
Arcanum Science: A Architecture of Sacred Sciences & Wisdom, B Interactions: Magic & Grimoires, C Esoteric Schools & Traditions, eleven sections, 79 pages
Projects: Chronos simulators (interactive, offline, in their own hierarchy) and Sacred Geometry (curriculum and 3D explorer)
Tag chips that filter every page
Content from the Projects-Library-KG repository, cloned read-only and cached offline

guide: Open the side menu: Modern Science, Arcanum Science or Projects, then a hub and a topic.
Pick a subpage tab at the top.
Tap a tag chip to filter, a node in the graph to open its page.
Open Chronos in the side menu, then a simulator below it.
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. The app downloads the public Projects-Library-KG repository from GitHub (read-only, per the refresh mode on the Chronos page) and otherwise reads the pages from Cloud Store's local data provider.

related.why: Opens this app from Cloud > Apps > Projects.
Installs and updates this app and serves its pages.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
